features.name: Workspace Setup
feature_descriptions: app有一个自己的metadata存储，对于windows可以放在用户的appdata目录
metadata存储记录了用户的信息，比如projects
用户的projects是一个一个的文件夹，里面包含了每个拍摄项目相关的文件
项目打开界面将会显示所有的projects，显示前三个，并且用一个滑块拖动查看后面的项目，项目用一张图片（如果项目中有图片）展示，如果没有图片，则显示项目名字
点击项目后可以打开这个主界面
页面的菜单栏有文件下拉菜单，可以选择新建、关闭、打开，打开新窗口等，打开新项目就会让你重新选择一个项目所在的目录
每个项目文件夹下面有一个.preshot的文件表示这是一个preshot项目，打开项目必须检索到这个文件才能支持打开
打开app后直接进入最近编辑的项目（无需先显示所有项目的开始页），最左侧栏显示按最后编辑时间排序（最新在最上）的项目列表，点击列表中的项目即可切换项目
decisions: Use TypeScript domain use cases with narrow Tauri adapters and Rust filesystem commands.
Store workspace metadata in AppData through Tauri Store.
Use a versioned JSON .preshot manifest with project identity and timestamps.
Create projects by selecting a parent directory and entering a project name.
Use an editorial horizontal gallery showing three recent projects at a time.
Resolve covers from manifest coverImage, then the first supported root image.
Keep invalid projects visible and require matching project IDs for relocation.
Use a native Tauri File menu; new windows start the same auto-open flow.

Auto-open the most recently edited available project on startup into a left project-switcher rail (sorted by updatedAt desc); show the launcher only when no available project exists, and route unavailable-project clicks there to recover them.

completed: Enabled Tauri Store and Dialog dependencies, permissions, and CSP.
Implemented typed workspace registry rules and serialized workspace use cases.
Implemented guarded Rust project creation, inspection, cover resolution, and token-authorized rollback.
Implemented Store, Dialog, native command, menu event, and structured logging adapters.
Implemented the accessible three-card recent-project launcher and new-project dialog.
Integrated WorkspaceProvider, explicit production/E2E dependencies, native File menu, and multi-window launcher behavior.
Hardened the native menu callback so guarded-action failures never surface as unhandled promise rejections.
Made the in-memory workspace adapter fail closed in production builds so it stays end-to-end only.
Prevented a busy create submission from closing the dialog without creating a project.
Added the memory-adapter E2E browser flow and documented workspace architecture, testing, and reliability.
lastVerified: Playwright browser smoke test and init.ps1 harness test passed.
ESLint, TypeScript typecheck, and cargo fmt --check passed.
pnpm build and pnpm tauri:build succeeded, producing MSI and NSIS bundles.

features.name: 基础方案编辑
feature_descriptions: project打开后，首先最重要的一栏是方案
点击方案，右侧会显示几个tab，分别是摄影计划、参考样图
参考样图可以添加多组，每组可以编辑每行显示的图片数量，然后按照这个去排版
显示的时候将每张图压缩到1:1放入一行，鼠标点击之后，显示这个图片的完整内容
摄影计划和参考样图显示在同一个面板中（无需切换tab），所见即所得
摄影计划与每组描述支持富文本编辑（HTML），基于 TipTap，向后兼容旧的纯文本
每组参考样图带有一个可编辑的描述文本框，标题与描述使用黑色高对比字体
project状态每隔5秒自动保存：检测到变化才写入.preshot，无变化则跳过
面板顶部显示保存状态（保存中/未保存/已保存），支持 Ctrl/Cmd+S 立即保存
将方案与参考样图排版导出为 A4 PDF；图片按每行数量以正方形站位等比留白填充
导出 PDF 时弹出保存位置对话框，默认保存到项目目录下的 output.pdf
主界面采用三栏布局：左侧项目栏约15%、中间方案区约60%、右侧约25%为预留的对话/agent面板（底部含输入框占位）
参考样图缩略图限定为固定尺寸（最大约160px方格），避免占比过大
富文本编辑器提供工具栏：加粗、斜体、下划线、删除线、标题、列表、字号、颜色、链接，所见即所得
导出的 PDF 中每张图片占据固定正方形站位并带浅灰色外框标示范围，图片按尺寸在框内留白；文本渲染支持下划线、删除线、颜色与字号
富文本编辑器改用 BlockNote，提供 Notion 风格的块编辑（斜杠菜单、拖拽块、清单/表格/代码块），方案与每组描述统一；持久化仍为 HTML，向后兼容旧内容
参考样图支持鼠标拖拽重新排序：可在组内调整顺序，也可拖到其它组；松开在非法位置则取消，移动后原组图片自动回填空位
拖动参考样图时实时预览松手后的排版效果：其余图片让位显示插入位置（可插到组的最前、中间、结尾，也可拖入空的组），所见即所得；仅移动单张图并回填，不做换位
decisions: Implement Photography Plan and per-group description rich-text editing with a shared TipTap editor.
Store plan data inside the versioned .preshot manifest as an optional plan field (schemaVersion 1).
Move imported images into a references/ subfolder, renumbered; accept only jpg/png up to 16MB.
Render reference images as on-demand base64 data URLs via narrow Rust commands, not the asset protocol.
Display images as 1:1 squares in configurable per-row grids; clicking expands a lightbox.
Reuse the workspace layering: pure domain PlanService use cases, Tauri adapters, and narrow Rust commands.
Merge Photography Plan and Reference Images into one scrollable panel (no tabs) for a WYSIWYG plan view.
Give each reference group an editable description (persisted on blur) with high-contrast black title and description text; ReferenceGroup.description defaults to empty for older manifests.
Store TipTap schema-safe HTML in .preshot, keep edits in memory with 5-second auto-save flushing, and stay backward-compatible with legacy plain-text content.

Auto-save the plan every 5s from ProjectPlanProvider with JSON change detection (skip writes when unchanged); pure-metadata edits defer to the loop while file side-effect ops (import/remove/delete-group) save immediately, plus an unmount flush. PlanService.savePlan is the single persistence use case.
Use native pdf-lib + fontkit export with bundled Noto Sans SC, square contain-fit image slots, and saving via the dialog + save_pdf command.
Default the PDF export save dialog to <project>/output.pdf.
Adopt a three-column app shell (15% projects / 60% plan / 25% Assistant preview) with a disabled bottom input reserved for a future agent.
Cap reference thumbnails at ~160px squares (grid minmax(0,160px), left-aligned) so the gallery stays bounded.
Extend the shared rich-text toolbar with underline, strikethrough, font-size (custom TextStyle FontSize extension), and color, rendered WYSIWYG via .ProseMirror styles.
Render underline/strikethrough/color/font-size runs in the exported PDF and draw a light-gray frame around every square image slot.

Replace TipTap with BlockNote (0.52, Mantine) in both the plan body and group descriptions; keep HTML persistence via tryParseHTMLToBlocks/blocksToHTMLLossy (no migration); adopt native BlockNote formatting (drop font-size/hex); PDF renders checklists as bullets, code as preformatted text, tables flattened; editor coverage shifts to e2e with mocked component tests.

Add reference-image drag-and-drop with @dnd-kit (confined to src/features/plan): a pure moveImage reducer + non-persisting use case (deferred 5s auto-save, no file I/O) and a pure resolveImageMove helper; whole-tile drag with a pointer activation distance so clicks still open the lightbox; invalid drops cancel; drop logic is unit-tested (jsdom cannot drive real drags).

Drag preview shows the post-drop layout live by reusing the moveImage reducer on an optimistic copy (preview === commit); a pure computeDropTarget/dropTargetFromEvent maps the dnd-kit event to {toGroupId,toIndex} for front/middle/end, cross-group, and empty-group insertion; v1 resolveImageMove/handleImageDragEnd removed.

completed: Brainstormed intent and scope, approved the design, and committed the spec.
Wrote the task-by-task TDD implementation plan (13 tasks).
Implemented the pure plan domain: models, reducers, and a serialized PlanService.
Added narrow Rust commands (save/read plan, import/load/remove reference image) storing plan in the .preshot manifest and images under references/.
Added Tauri and in-memory plan adapters plus fail-closed dependency composition.
Built the Plan panel, Reference Images gallery, and lightbox UI, wired into the opened project.
Added the E2E browser flow and documented the feature in ARCHITECTURE and TESTING.

Merged Photography Plan and Reference Images into one tab-free scrollable panel, upgraded the Photography Plan body and per-group descriptions to shared rich-text editing, and kept title/description contrast black.
Added a 5s change-detected auto-save in ProjectPlanProvider (metadata edits deferred, file ops immediate, unmount flush) backed by a new PlanService.savePlan use case.
Added a live SaveStatus indicator (saving/unsaved/saved) in the PlanPanel header and a Ctrl/Cmd+S shortcut that flushes immediately.
Added A4 PDF export (pure domain export document + geometry, pdf-lib/fontkit with bundled Noto Sans SC, dialog/save_pdf save path) and covered it with browser smoke + docs.

Optimized the plan workflow: PDF export defaults to <project>/output.pdf via the save dialog; the main window uses a 15/60/25 three-column shell with an Assistant preview panel and a disabled bottom input; reference thumbnails are capped at ~160px squares; the rich-text toolbar gained underline/strikethrough/font-size/color WYSIWYG controls; and the PDF renders those marks plus a light-gray frame around each square image slot.

Migrated the shared rich-text editor from TipTap to BlockNote (Notion-style block editing) with a compact description variant, HTML-boundary conversion, jsdom shims + mocked component tests, an e2e editing smoke, and PDF handling for BlockNote block types.

Fixed a hydration echo where BlockNote emitted onChange on programmatic load, which flipped a project to unsaved on open and rewrote .preshot into normalized HTML; the editor now suppresses the load echo so existing content loads unchanged.
Added drag-and-drop reordering of reference images within and across groups (dnd-kit) backed by a pure moveImage reducer/use case and a pure drop resolver, with deferred auto-save persistence.
Kept image tiles keyboard-openable by using a pointer-only sensor (dragging is mouse/pointer only) and used closestCorners collision for precise slot insertion.

Added WYSIWYG live-reflow preview for reference-image dragging (tiles reflow to the insertion point across groups incl. empty), reusing the moveImage reducer so the preview matches the committed move; drop-target math is pure and unit-tested with an e2e drag.

Fixed an infinite render loop when dragging into an empty group: onDragOver now only updates the preview for a valid, changed target and never reverts mid-drag (dnd-kit re-fires onDragOver on measuring changes).

Fixed reference-image drops silently not committing into empty/other groups: onDragEnd now commits the release-time target and falls back to the last previewed target when the pointer is released over the dragged tile's own previewed slot (over === activeId → null), so both within-group reordering and cross/empty-group drops commit.

Made dropping onto an empty group reliable by switching dnd-kit collision detection to pointer-within (fallback closest-corners): the droppable the pointer is inside — including an empty group's '+' slot — is targeted directly, instead of a distance heuristic that could favour a larger neighbouring group over a small empty container.

Made dragging more sensitive: collision detection now uses rect-intersection (the image tile the dragged image overlaps most wins, group containers skipped so tile positioning beats append; pointer-within/closest-corners remain the fallback for empty groups and gaps), and same-group drop math uses array-move semantics so the active image takes the over tile's slot as soon as it overlaps it most — no longer requiring the pointer to travel past the tile's centre. Empty-group drops keep working via the fallback.

Fixed the left project rail: the app shell is now a fixed-height flex column (h-screen + overflow-hidden) so only the middle plan panel scrolls internally and the New/Open project actions stay pinned in the sidebar instead of scrolling away with the page. The projects list is capped at ~15 rows (max-h-[38rem] + overflow-y-auto, shrinks on short viewports) with a scrollbar beyond 15, and the actions are anchored to the bottom via a flex spacer.

Fixed a regression from the fixed-height shell where the middle plan panel could not scroll (groups below the fold were clipped): completed the flex min-h-0 chain by adding min-h-0 to the Workspace <main>, so PlanPanel's overflow-y-auto is height-bounded and scrolls. Covered by an e2e that asserts the panel is scrollable and reveals the last group.

features.name: Internationalization Foundation
feature_descriptions: Application defaults to Chinese (zh) language across the entire UI
Implemented react-i18next with typed translation keys for type-safe localization
All user-facing strings use localized translation keys (shell, agent, plan, reference, workspace, dialogs, errors)
Chinese demo seed content: photography plan '日落大片' and reference group '造型参考'
BlockNote editor configured with Chinese dictionary for block menu and UI elements
Generic error banners display Chinese messages
Browser demo seed and e2e tests updated to Chinese strings
Full Chinese UI covers: project launcher, workspace navigation, plan editing, reference images, save status, PDF export, BlockNote editor, lightbox, dialogs, and error boundaries
decisions: Use react-i18next (v15.3) with typed keys via i18next module augmentation of CustomTypeOptions with resources: { translation: typeof zh } for compile-time safety
Store Chinese translations in src/shared/i18n/locales/zh.ts as a const object for type inference
Configure i18next with lng: 'zh', fallbackLng: 'zh' so the app defaults to Chinese without browser language detection
Localize BlockNote editor using the built-in @blocknote/core/locales zh dictionary export imported directly for type safety
Use t() in all React components for UI strings; app chrome, reference labels, save status, workspace launcher, and error messages all go through i18n
Update browser demo seed to Chinese (static data, not i18n keys) so the seeded project displays Chinese content on first launch
Update all e2e Playwright queries to Chinese strings to match the localized UI (role/text queries for buttons, save status, group names, etc.)
Keep structural aria-labels (e.g., PlanPanel outer 'Plan') unlocalised when they are not user-visible

completed: Installed react-i18next (v15.3) and i18next; configured i18next with lng: 'zh', fallbackLng: 'zh', and typed resources

Built a typed zh translation dictionary covering all UI surfaces: shell (projects, tagline, actions), agent (preview, input), plan (export, tab labels, block editor), reference (add/remove/open image, groups), save status (saving/unsaved/saved), workspace (launcher intro, cards, dialogs), errors (workspace/plan generic messages, error boundary)
Wrapped App with I18nextProvider and tested i18n initialization

Localized AppShell (tagline, projects nav), AgentPanel (title, preview, input), PlanPanel (export button, save status), PhotographyPlanTab (section label), ReferenceImagesTab (heading, add group button), ReferenceGroup (title/description labels, delete/add image), SortableImageTile (open/remove image aria-labels), ReferenceImageLightbox (close button), SaveStatus (statuses), WorkspaceLauncher (intro, actions, empty state), ProjectRail (recent projects, previous/next hints), ProjectCard (open/relocate/remove actions, unavailable hint), CreateProjectDialog (eyebrow, title, labels, cancel/create), GenericErrorBanner (workspace/plan messages), and AppErrorBoundary (title, body)

Configured BlockNote editor with the built-in @blocknote/core/locales zh dictionary imported directly via import { zh } from '@blocknote/core/locales' and passed to useCreateBlockNote({ dictionary: zh }) for type-safe Notion-style block editing in Chinese

Updated browser demo seed (browserPlan.ts SEEDED_PLAN) to Chinese: '日落大片' photography plan, '造型参考' reference group title/description; updated browserWorkspace.ts demo project name to '编辑大片示例'; updated corresponding test assertions

Updated all e2e Playwright queries to Chinese: plan.spec.ts ('参考分组：造型参考', '打开参考图 X', '添加参考图', '添加参考分组', '导出 PDF', '正在导出…', '关闭图片', '已保存所有更改', '有未保存的更改', '摄影计划'), layout.spec.ts ('新建项目', '打开项目', '添加参考分组', '参考分组：新建分组', '添加参考图', and PlanPanel structural 'Plan' kept as-is), workspace.spec.ts ('项目', '打开项目 编辑大片示例', '添加参考分组')
Ran full validation matrix: pnpm typecheck (clean), pnpm lint (clean), pnpm test (207 tests passed), pnpm test:e2e (10 e2e tests passed), pnpm build (succeeded)

features.name: Canvas Component System
feature_descriptions: Plan editing migrated from fixed v1 tabs to a flexible v2 canvas component system
A4-based flow layout: components stack vertically, auto-paginate with WYSIWYG page breaks
Insert menu: add Plan or Reference components via button; drag handle to reorder components
Plan component: BlockNote rich-text editor, configurable height, seeds with Chinese default template (拍摄时间/拍摄地点/道具和服装/器材)

Reference component: configurable title, optional description, columns-per-row grid, image import, drag-to-reorder images within group, per-component caption toggle with per-image editable caption boxes (screen + PDF)
Resize handles: adjust component widths (1/2, 2/3, 1) and heights interactively
PDF export: render canvas to multi-page A4 PDF preserving exact WYSIWYG layout with font subsetting (small file sizes), image slots fit gutter-inset content box
Persistent schemaVersion 2 format in .preshot manifest (v1 removed)
Auto-save: 5s debounced save with save-status indicator, Ctrl/Cmd+S shortcut
Add-description affordance: button reveals the description editor when description is empty
decisions: Adopt a v2 schemaVersion 2 plan model (ProjectPlan.components array) with Plan and Reference component types, each with id, widthFraction (1 | 1/2 | 2/3), height, and type-specific fields
Build pure domain canvas engine: A4 pagination, flow layout (single column, no CSS Grid complexity), geometry (containSize, reflowPages), and WYSIWYG insert/move/resize reducers
Implement canvas service: loadPlan (migrate v1 → v2), insertComponent, moveComponent, resizeComponent, updatePlanHtml, setReference* mutators, importImage (files reused across versions)
Build ProjectCanvasProvider: manages canvas state, debounced auto-save, PDF export orchestration, picker/image loading wiring
PlanCanvas UI: renders A4 pages + page-break indicators; each component gets a chrome (drag handle, insert-below menu, delete button, resize handles)
Plan component view: BlockNote editor (zh locale), height resize
Reference component view: title input, columns select, optional description editor, GroupImageGrid (reused from v1), height resize
Insert component menu: dropdown (Plan / Reference), insert below target or at end
Canvas drop geometry: @dnd-kit sortable components (pointer sensor, closestCenter collision, vertical list), drop indicator lines
Canvas PDF exporter: reuse htmlToBlocks tokenizer + Noto Sans SC fonts, render each component with A4 pagination, square image slots, WYSIWYG to pdf-lib output

Remove v1: delete ProjectPlanProvider, PlanPanel, PhotographyPlanTab, ReferenceImagesTab, dropTarget, v1 domain (models/plan/service/pdf), v1 pdfLibExporter; keep reused GroupImageGrid/SortableImageTile/ReferenceImageLightbox/htmlToBlocks/fonts; remove v1 ports/tauriPlan/browserPlan exports
Wire canvas as default: planDependencies.ts returns createCanvasPlanDependencies (v2); Workspace.tsx renders ProjectCanvasProvider

Phase C: plan default template (i18n content.planTemplate) seeded on insert; per-component caption toggle (reference.captions) + per-image editable caption boxes (reference.captionAria, content.captionPlaceholder) wired to ReferenceImage.caption; add-description button (reference.addDescription) reveals description editor; PDF font subsetting enabled for smaller file sizes (~16 MB → <1 MB)

Phase D: within-group image drag-reorder (@dnd-kit nested droppables: image tiles are sortable, GroupImageGrid is an image group droppable, PlanCanvas has a parallel image drag path with optimistic moveImage preview, ProjectCanvasProvider.handleMoveImage applies it client-side, 5s auto-save persists); PDF image slots now fit the gutter-inset content box (previously overflowed ~6 pt)

completed: Designed canvas component system: v2 model, A4 flow engine, WYSIWYG insert/move/resize, component-level PDF export

Phase A: implemented v2 domain (canvas/models, canvas/geometry, canvas/engine pagination/layout, canvas/plan reducers, canvas/service with v1 migration, canvas/pdf/exportDocument, canvas/dropTarget, canvas/canvasDropGeometry)
Phase B task 1-3: built ProjectCanvasProvider (state/save/export wiring), PlanCanvas (A4 pages + chrome), PlanComponentView (BlockNote editor)
Phase B task 4-5: built ReferenceComponentView (reused GroupImageGrid), InsertComponentMenu, useComponentResize hook
Phase B task 6: built canvasPdfExporter (htmlToBlocks-based, multi-page A4 output)
Phase B task 7: wired canvas as the default plan view in Workspace.tsx + planDependencies.ts

Phase B task 8 (final): removed v1 model/UI/PDF (ProjectPlanProvider, PlanPanel, PhotographyPlanTab, ReferenceImagesTab, dropTarget, domain/plan/{models,plan,service,pdf/*}, pdfLibExporter); removed v1 exports from tauriPlan/browserPlan; kept reused GroupImageGrid/SortableImageTile/ReferenceImageLightbox (structural interface), htmlToBlocks, font assets; moved PdfSaveTarget to canvas/ports

Phase C: delivered plan default template (content.planTemplate i18n key); per-component caption toggle + per-image editable caption boxes (ReferenceImage.caption, screen + PDF); add-description affordance button; PDF font subsetting (reduced file size from ~16 MB to <1 MB)
Phase D task 1: fixed PDF image slots to fit gutter-inset content box (previously overflowed ~6 pt horizontally)

Phase D task 2-3: implemented within-group image drag-reorder (pure imageDropTarget helper, imageInsertAfterFromRects geometry, nested dnd-kit droppables, optimistic moveImage preview + commit via ProjectCanvasProvider.handleMoveImage, 5s auto-save persists)
Phase D task 4 (final): added e2e for image reorder (mirrors component reorder test, asserts committed order change via data-image-id), updated featurelist, ran full validation matrix

lastVerified.e2eTests: 15 tests passed (canvas insert/reorder/resize/image/PDF/plan-template/captions/image-reorder-testability, layout scroll, workspace auto-open)

decisions: Replace fractional presets with continuous drag: widthFraction is a number 0.4–1.0 clamped and quantized to 0.01 step; double-click handles snap to 0.5/0.67/1.0; remove WidthResizeMenu dropdown entirely
Unified SPACING constant = 24px for all canvas margins, gaps, and handle sizes (DRY, visual rhythm)

Drag handle extends to the entire top bar: move handle becomes invisible (w-0, opacity-0, focusable for a11y); the top bar itself is draggable; low-emphasis gray type label added for component identification

Four-edge resizing: add left/top/bottom handles to ComponentFrame; ResizeDirection enum ('width' | 'height' | 'both' | 'left' | 'top'); useComponentResize hook recognizes all five directions; resizeComponent reducer clamps width 0.4–1.0 and height 120–1000
Delete confirmation: wrap ComponentFrame delete in AlertDialog with 删除/取消 actions; deletion only commits on 删除
Insert at top (array.unshift): insertComponent reducer prepends to components array at index 0 instead of pushing to end; WYSIWYG matches user expectation for stacking order
Seed plan + reference on project creation: EMPTY_PLAN_V3 factory includes one plan component (seeded with content.planTemplate) and one reference component (title '新建分组')

Reference image aspect ratio: SortableImageTile renders img at natural aspect ratio (height: auto, max-h: imageHeight) instead of 1:1; ReferenceComponent.imageHeight controls the max-height (default 160); ReferenceComponentView adds a stepper (±20, range 60–300) to adjust imageHeight per component
Multi-select images: Tauri dialog filter multiple: true; import_images command loops and maps the file array; createReferenceImage generates sequential IDs for batch import

PDF export folder reveal: export_canvas_to_pdf returns the saved PDF path; a new export_folder Rust command invokes platform-specific folder-reveal (Windows: explorer /select, macOS: open -R, Linux: xdg-open parent); ProjectCanvasProvider calls it after save completes

SchemaVersion 3 migration: CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 3; migrateV2ToV3 converts widthFraction strings to numbers (map {1/2→0.5, 2/3→0.67, 1→1}), adds imageHeight: 160 to reference components; loadPlan chains migrateV1ToV2 → migrateV2ToV3
feature_descriptions: Continuous component width: drag any border (left/right) to adjust width fluidly; widthFraction persisted as number (0.4–1.0, step 0.01); double-click handles snap to presets (1/2, 2/3, 1)
Unified spacing constant: SPACING = 24px for top/left/right margins, inter-component gaps, and handle sizes
Move components by whole top bar: draggable area is the entire top bar (not just the drag handle icon); low-emphasis type label (摄影计划/参考图组) helps identify components
Four-edge + corner resize: drag left/right edges for width, top/bottom for height, bottom-right corner for both; height 120–1000px
Delete confirmation dialog: clicking × shows AlertDialog ('确定删除该组件？') before removing the component
Insert at top: new components always insert at index 0, not at the end
Seeded new projects: fresh projects seed with a plan component + a reference component (both at default widthFraction 1)

Reference images natural aspect ratio: tiles render at per-image natural height (no 1:1 squashing); configurable per-component imageHeight (default 160, range 60–300, ±20 stepper, i18n reference.imageHeight label)
Multi-select image insert: native file picker supports multiple file selection; images import in chosen order
PDF export reveals folder: after save completes, the export-folder Rust command opens the parent directory in Explorer/Finder/native file manager

SchemaVersion 3: ProjectPlan.schemaVersion incremented to 3; widthFraction now number; referenceComponents gain imageHeight; v2 → v3 migration converts 1/2/2/3 strings to 0.5/0.67/1, adds imageHeight: 160

features.name: Theming + Settings
feature_descriptions: Support light, dark, and system theme modes
In-app settings panel accessible via gear button (设置) for theme selection
Theme persistence in ~/.preshot/settings.json via Tauri commands (read_settings/write_settings)

features.name: Undo / Redo
feature_descriptions: Session-scoped structural undo/redo for the canvas via 撤销/重做 toolbar buttons and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y
Structural-only scope: add/remove/move/resize components, image add/remove/reorder/caption, image height, group title, and caption toggle are undoable
Rich-text editing (plan body and reference description) is left to BlockNote's own Ctrl+Z; the global handler never fights the editor
On undo/redo the structural snapshot is restored while the CURRENT html/description of components surviving by id is preserved (structural undo never rewinds typed text)
Capped (~50) in-memory snapshot history, reset on each project open; never persisted
Consecutive same-target resize/image-height changes within a short window coalesce into a single undo entry
decisions: Pure snapshot history in src/domain/plan/canvas/history.ts (createHistory/record/undo/redo/canUndo/canRedo) — no React/DOM/Tauri, deep-copied snapshots, never throws
mergeStructural(target, current) keeps current html/description for components surviving by id+type so a structural undo preserves BlockNote text

ProjectCanvasProvider (the single applyPlan mutation point) records the previous plan via a history-aware mutate helper for structural handlers; text handlers (handleChangeHtml/handleSetDescription) stay on plain applyPlan
Coalesce resize bursts with key resize:<id> and image-height with imageHeight:<id> within COALESCE_WINDOW_MS (600ms)
Keyboard: window keydown routes Ctrl+Z to BlockNote when a contenteditable/INPUT/TEXTAREA/.bn-editor/.ProseMirror is focused, else global undo; Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y redo
History is per-session (reset on load, not persisted); async image handlers capture prev at the pre-change point and record exactly once on success

Removal undo is reference-level: removeImage/removeComponent eagerly delete backing files, so undo of a removal is correct in-session (renders from the imageSrc cache) but not durable across a save+reload (a restored image points at a deleted file). Durable remove-undo needs save-time orphan collection / session trash — tracked as a Storage follow-up.

features.name: Windows MSI Installer
feature_descriptions: pnpm tauri:build on Windows emits a WiX MSI (Preshot_<ver>_x64_en-US.msi)
Installs to Program Files (per-machine) with a Start Menu shortcut and a Desktop shortcut, plus an Add/Remove Programs uninstaller
~/.preshot is created by the app at first run (theming settings command), not by the installer

decisions: Use Tauri's WiX (WiX Toolset v3) MSI target — bundle.targets=["msi"] — not NSIS, matching the PRD's .msi requirement

Tauri v2's default WiX template already defines and ships ApplicationShortcutDesktop (Desktop) + ApplicationShortcut (Start Menu) + an uninstall shortcut via its ShortcutsFeature, so NO custom WiX fragment is needed; a shortcuts.wxs redefining ApplicationShortcutDesktop fails the linker with LGHT0091 (duplicate symbol)
Set bundle.publisher=yucdong (WiX Manufacturer) and bundle.windows.wix.language=["en-US"]
A Vitest config-contract test (src/app/packaging/msiConfig.test.ts) guards targets=["msi"], publisher, and en-US so the bundle config can't silently drift
Unsigned MSI for now; per-machine install with per-user ~/.preshot at runtime; no PATH change
